findings.title: Criterion 1 of REQ-061 (done) is no longer met as written: /3 is now an accepted format and the schema message names /1, /2 and /3
findings.evidence: Copy of e-field-schema.json outside the project with schema «sai-picker-tenant/3»: `node src/picker/cli.js check` — code 1, 34 lines, first «e-field-schema.json: look: E_FIELD: Нет поля look. Добавьте его.»; with «sai-picker-tenant/»: code 1, «e-field-schema.json: schema: E_FIELD: Допустимо только: sai-picker-tenant/1, sai-picker-tenant/2 или sai-picker-tenant/3. Исправьте значение.»; the sample in the project holds «sai-picker-tenant/4» (commit cd789f5, REQ-069). The criterion still expects code 1 and «Допустимо только: sai-picker-tenant/1 или sai-picker-tenant/2.» for /3 and for the sample.
findings.item: Q1 (each criterion names a way of checking that is true), Q14 (records follow the change)
findings.recommendation: WF-01 (REQ-ANALYST, REQ-VALIDATOR): amend criterion 1 of REQ-061 the way REQ-069 (description, item (а)) already amended the test LG-1c — the wrong values become «sai-picker-tenant/4» and «sai-picker-tenant/», the expected line «Допустимо только: sai-picker-tenant/1, sai-picker-tenant/2 или sai-picker-tenant/3. Исправьте значение.», the sample value /4; with a was → became row and a reference to REQ-069. No code change: the behaviour is the one REQ-069 decided (decisions/0085). Then RELEASE-VALIDATOR re-checks the criterion (WF-03, steps 9–10).
